headline: Cargill brings Coconera CBA to Europe; disease-resistant cacao; sourdough clean-label research
summary: Cargill launched its Coconera cocoa butter alternative in Europe at Fi Europe, a direct competitive challenge to Belcolade compounds and coatings while cocoa costs stay high.
A new disease-resistant cacao plant is being positioned as a fix for disease threats to global chocolate supply; Belcolade sourcing should identify the developer and assess partnership potential.

University of Alberta research shows sourdough shortens bread ingredient lists but still needs enzymes for some functions, backing Puratos's combined Sapore and enzyme clean-label approach, while Cain Foods pushes competing fermented shelf-life ingredients.

US bakeries keep extending sourdough and gluten-free lines (Toufayan sourdough pita, Rudi's gluten-free), and Flowers Foods is working to revive Dave's Killer Bread, all openings for Puratos Bakery solutions.
Regulatory: EUDR due-diligence duties for chocolate makers and US sodium-reduction pressure on bread are the changes to prepare for, and Canada has revoked two PFAS food additive authorisations.

items.title: Fi Europe 2026 live: Cargill brings Coconera cocoa butter alternative to Europe
items.summary: At Fi Europe 2026, Cargill brought its Coconera cocoa butter alternative to the European market.
items.why: A major supplier's cocoa butter alternative arriving in Europe is a direct competitive move against Belcolade compounds and coatings as cocoa costs stay high.

items.title: Enzymatic and Microbial Modification of Carbohydrates for Improved Bread Quality and Nutritional Functionality
items.summary: University of Alberta thesis on sourdough and enzyme modification of wheat carbohydrates for clean-label bread, finding sourdough shortens ingredient lists but cannot yet replace all additives.
items.why: Supports Puratos's clean-label improver plus sourdough strategy and maps which additive functions still need enzymes, a good basis for S500/Sapore combinations.

items.title: Global Chocolate Supply Threatened by Disease, New Cacao Plant Offers Solution
items.summary: Food Manufacturing reports a new disease-resistant cacao plant presented as a solution to disease threats to global chocolate supply.
items.why: Disease-resistant cacao could stabilise supply and prices for Belcolade; worth identifying the developer for Cacao-Trace sourcing partnerships.

items.title: Incorporation of Spirulina and Moringa into Dark Chocolate: Physicochemical and Nutritional Properties, Activated Carbon Deodorization, Sensory Quality, And In Vitro Gut Microbiota Responses
items.summary: University of Delaware thesis replacing cocoa powder in dark chocolate with spirulina and moringa, using activated-carbon deodorisation to tame off-flavours and testing gut-microbiota effects.
items.why: A US academic route to protein-rich, partly cocoa-free dark chocolate that Belcolade could track for cocoa-reduction and functional chocolate ideas.

items.title: Fermentation Strategies in Baked Foods and Novel Plant-based Foods: Functionality, Preservation, Sustainability and Authentication
items.summary: University of Alberta thesis on fermentation strategies for baked and plant-based foods, including Bacillus spp. to improve bread quality and DNA methods to authenticate sourdough bread.
items.why: Ganzle-lab work on sourdough authentication and Bacillus starters is directly relevant to Sapore sourdough claims and is a natural academic partner for Bakery.

items.title: Effect of Soy Protein Isolate and Textured Soy Protein Nugget Blends on Dough Rheological Properties and Bread Quality
items.summary: Kansas State study showing that blending soy protein isolate with textured soy nuggets lets bakers add high protein to wheat bread while improving volume and softness versus isolate alone.
items.why: Practical formulation insight for high-protein bread mixes and improvers aimed at North American industrial bakers.

items.title: Clean label bread formulating: Balancing flavor and shelf life
items.summary: Baking Business piece in which Cain Foods explains how fermented ingredients help clean-label bread bakers balance flavour and mould-free shelf life.
items.why: Cain Foods is a direct competitor in cultured-wheat clean-label preservation, an area where Puratos's sourdough and enzyme shelf-life offers compete.

items.title: Rudi’s Bakery Introduces Two New Certified Gluten Free Innovations
items.summary: Rudi's Bakery launched two new certified gluten-free bread products in the US.
items.why: A competitor/customer move in North American gluten-free bread, a signal for Puratos gluten-free mixes and improvers.

items.title: Toufayan Bakeries launches sourdough pita bread
items.summary: Toufayan Bakeries launched a Simply Sourdough pita line with three products.
items.why: Another US bakery extending sourdough into flatbreads, an opening for Sapore sourdough solutions in ethnic breads.

items.title: EUDR Due Diligence for Cocoa and Coffee Operators
items.summary: Guide on EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) due-diligence statements for cocoa and coffee operators, covering importers, grinders and chocolate makers.
items.why: EUDR due-diligence duties apply to Belcolade as a chocolate maker and importer, so traceability data must be in place for the compliance deadline.

items.title: Your favorite foods may soon contain less sodium
items.summary: Earth.com reports that packaged foods may soon contain less sodium, pointing to US sodium-reduction targets.
items.why: FDA's voluntary sodium-reduction targets put bread, a top sodium source, in focus; Bakery should have salt-reduction improver and sourdough solutions ready for US customers.

items.title: Dynamics of volatile and bioactive compounds in Criollo cocoa during spontaneous and Saccharomyces cerevisiae-inoculated fermentation and drying
items.summary: Study tracking volatile and bioactive compounds in Criollo cocoa during spontaneous versus Saccharomyces cerevisiae-inoculated fermentation and drying.
items.why: Starter-culture cocoa fermentation is a lever for consistent flavour in fine-flavour origins that Belcolade sources.

items.title: Cadmio en cacao: qué exigen Codex y la Unión Europea, y dónde está Colombia frente a esos límites
items.summary: Note comparing Codex and EU cadmium limits for cocoa and chocolate with Colombian cocoa cadmium levels.
items.why: Cadmium limits constrain which origins Belcolade can use in dark chocolate; Colombian sourcing needs cadmium screening.

items.title: Flowers Foods focused on reviving Dave’s Killer Bread
items.summary: Flowers Foods is focusing on reviving sales of its Dave's Killer Bread brand.
items.why: Flowers is a key US industrial bakery customer; its push to revive a premium seeded/organic brand may create demand for new grains, inclusions and improver solutions.

items.title: La Lorraine Romania reaches 70,000 tonnes in annual bakery pr ...
items.summary: La Lorraine Romania reached 70,000 tonnes of annual bakery production.
items.why: La Lorraine Bakery Group is a large European frozen-bakery player, both a potential customer and a scale benchmark.

items.title: Compound Chocolate Market Forecast to Reach USD 44.1 Billion by 2034, Growing at 4.8% CAGR | Fact.MR
items.summary: Fact.MR forecasts the compound chocolate market will reach USD 44.1 billion by 2034, growing at 4.8% a year.
items.why: Continued compound-chocolate growth supports Belcolade's compound and coating portfolio as cocoa prices push customers to alternatives.

items.title: Why Princes is eyeing up Mondelez’s French bakery and snacks business
items.summary: Princes is reportedly eyeing Mondelez's French bakery and snacks business.
items.why: A change of owner for Mondelez's French bakery assets could reshape a sizeable industrial bakery customer base in Europe.

items.title: Cookies are evolving in taste and texture
items.summary: Baking Business looks at how cookie brands are evolving taste and texture, using online trends to inspire products.
items.why: Trend input for cookie fillings, inclusions and textures that Puratos sells to sweet-goods customers.
